purpose: Validate Omnira's external READ_ONLY observation capability end to end through the real scheduler, run, executor and evidence path. This is a capability test, not a release process.
source_of_truth: This file. Authored in the Omnira repository; it describes Omnira's own validation procedure and is not derived from any product workflow.

canonical.scope: Capability validation only. This definition must never gain a human gate, a write action, a spend action or an external communication.
canonical.not_a_release: It performs no release, touches no customer-facing system and produces no artefact.

hard_gates.rule: Only READ_ONLY observations may ever be declared here. A write-capable action in this definition would give a gate-free workflow the ability to change the world.

never_auto.note: Requires a human decision before any retry.

states.description: Observe that unauthenticated callers are refused by every protected Familje-Stunden endpoint.
automated_actions: Probe both protected Edge Functions unauthenticated and record the exact statuses.
states.notes: No human gate by design: a READ_ONLY observation requires no authorization, and this definition may never carry anything that does.

escalation.detail: A protected Familje-Stunden endpoint answered 2xx to an unauthenticated caller.
escalation.reason: This is a security finding, not a failed test — protected material would be publicly reachable.
